speaker: male
text: [curious][emphasis] Your brain may be rewarding procrastination.

speaker: female
text: [concerned] You open a difficult assignment. Uncertainty, boredom, maybe fear appears.

speaker: male
text: [conversational] So you check your phone, and the discomfort drops instantly.

speaker: female
text: [realizing] Your brain learns: avoiding this task makes me feel better.

speaker: male
text: [measured and clear] Psychologists call this short-term mood repair.

speaker: male
text: [encouraging] Try this. Name the feeling, then make one if-then plan.

speaker: female
text: [confident] If I sit down after dinner, I open the file and write one sentence.

speaker: male
text: [emphasis] Make starting too small to fear.
